_doc: Canonical SPIRE model registry. Source of truth for /api/system/admin/models. The W1 task #30 supply-chain page reads from here. Honesty over hand-waving — anything that isn't yet real is labelled 'TBD — placeholder'.

models.name: PULSE Risk Scorer
models.purpose: Per-asset failure prediction across modeled components. Backs the PULSE Risk Board, Forecast tab, and recommend-actions endpoint.

rule_based_v1.summary: Logistic hazard regression on (current_hours / MTBF) with deterministic per-asset variance, recent-fault history bump, and overdue-PM linear boost. MTBF table and equipment profiles live in dataset/data/.

provenance.training_data_lineage: Hand-engineered MTBF table from USMC equipment profiles; no learned weights. Inputs: SR history, snapshot deadlines, days since maintenance.

hosting.actual: In-process Python alongside the FastAPI backend
hosting.gap: None — first-party in-process inference inherits the deployment posture; satisfies IL-5 / IL-6 boundaries by colocation.

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target*, not an active authorization. SPIRE is in pre-fielding posture; ATO paperwork lands with the receiving MEF G-6 once a host enclave is selected. Distinct from the operational IL boundary the deployed enclave inherits.

rule_based_v1.fedramp_note: First-party deterministic algorithm inside the SPIRE process. No SaaS dependency to assess.

vendor.name: SPIRE (Thornveil LLC)
vendor.contingency: First-party — no external pivot risk. If the rule-based scorer is ever retired in favor of a trained model, the rule-based path remains compiled in as fallback (see model_hooks.STATE).

validation.method: Backtest against 6-month SR history with held-out 20% of assets

inference_cost.notes: Pure CPU; cost is operator workstation power.

update_policy.cadence: Quarterly review of MTBF table; ad-hoc on observed failure-rate drift > 15%

torch_v0.summary: Placeholder lane for a PULSE-trained checkpoint loaded via SPIRE_PULSE_WEIGHTS. Inference glue lives in backend/model_hooks.py; ships disabled until the GH200 / RigRun training handoff produces a usable artifact.

provenance.training_data_lineage: TBD — placeholder. Anticipated: USMC fleet SR history under data-use agreement; cleansed via SENTRY before training.

hosting.gap: TBD — placeholder until the trained checkpoint exists

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target*. No ATO until weights exist and a receiving enclave is selected.

torch_v0.fedramp_note: Will inherit SPIRE deployment posture (in-process, no SaaS).

vendor.name: SPIRE / Thornveil
vendor.contingency: Rule-based v1 remains as fallback if the trained weights are pulled.

inference_cost.notes: Will fall back to rule_based_v1 (free) on inference failure.

models.name: SENTRY Classifier
models.purpose: Two-tier classification cascade for incoming SR remarks. Tier-1 pattern engine catches deterministic flags (PII, MGRS, COMSEC, controlled identifiers); Tier-2 language-model reviewer handles ambiguous routing.

rule_based_v1.summary: Deterministic regex ensemble across PII / geo / comms / classified / controlled flag families with confidence-routing policy (clean → 0.98, multi-flag → 0.85 escalates to Tier-2). Source: backend/routes/sentry.py tier1_classify.

provenance.training_data_lineage: Hand-curated regex patterns derived from CUI/PII/COMSEC redaction guides. No training corpus.

hosting.actual: In-process Python alongside the FastAPI backend

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target*, not an active authorization. SPIRE inherits whatever ATO the receiving enclave already holds; no SENTRY-specific package is on file.

vendor.name: SPIRE (Thornveil LLC)
vendor.contingency: First-party — patterns versioned in repo. Compromise of repo would be required to alter behavior.

validation.method: Pattern coverage harness in backend/tests; 1.24K-record gold set across PII / comms / classified.

update_policy.cadence: Pattern updates land via PR; gold-set regression runs per PR.

tier2_llm_gate.summary: Ambiguous-record escalation path. Tier-2 invokes the SPIRO copilot LLM (Gemma 4 26B FP8) with a constrained classification prompt. Cross-link → see copilot-llm model card.

provenance.publisher: Routing layer in SPIRE; underlying model documented under copilot-llm.

hosting.actual: Routes to local Gemma 4 via SPIRE_LLM_PROXY; never to commercial APIs.
hosting.gap: Cloud-routing aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus, openrouter, etc.) are filtered out of the proxy surface — see backend/routes/system._probe_llm_brief.

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target* of the underlying copilot LLM. The Tier-2 routing layer holds no separate ATO — see copilot-llm authorization block.

tier2_llm_gate.fedramp_note: Local inference path. SaaS routing is filtered out at the proxy layer.

vendor.name: Routing layer is first-party. Underlying model: Google (Gemma weights) — see copilot-llm card.
vendor.jurisdiction: United States (routing layer); see copilot-llm for weights jurisdiction
vendor.ownership: First-party routing; model weights detailed under copilot-llm.
vendor.contingency: If Tier-2 unavailable, ambiguous records fall to manual review queue rather than being passed through.

validation.method: Tier-2-only subset of the SENTRY gold set; measured against ground-truth routing.

inference_cost.notes: Cost reflects local rig power amortized per token; falls back to manual review at $0.

update_policy.cadence: Prompt updates land via PR; routing policy reviewed quarterly.

models.name: SPIRO Copilot LLM
models.purpose: Operator-facing assistant. Plans tool calls, answers natural-language questions across PULSE/SENTRY/BASTION data. Also serves as Tier-2 for the SENTRY classifier cascade.

gemma4_26b_fp8_local.summary: Gemma 4 26B FP8 served by vLLM behind SPIRE_LLM_PROXY (default http://127.0.0.1:8095). Cloud routing aliases (anthropic, openai, openrouter, etc.) are stripped from /v1/models before SPIRE renders model lists — confirmed in backend/routes/system._probe_llm_brief.

provenance.license: Gemma Terms of Use (open weights, redistributable per § 2)
provenance.training_data_lineage: Google-published training mix. SPIRE does not retrain — weights are loaded as-shipped.

hosting.actual: Local vLLM on operator rig (SPIRE_LLM_PROXY env var); 524288-token context window
hosting.gap: None — fully local inference. Network egress monitor (backend/network_monitor.py) blocks outbound to commercial LLM endpoints.

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target*. SPIRE has no Gemma-specific ATO package; weights run inside the SPIRE process, so the model inherits whatever authorization the receiving enclave already holds. Distinct from the IL-5 *authorization* a fielded ATO would carry.

gemma4_26b_fp8_local.fedramp_note: Self-hosted inference. SPIRE never calls a SaaS LLM in production posture; the network egress monitor enforces this.

vendor.name: Alphabet (US, weights publisher) / DeepMind (UK, research lab) — operated locally by SPIRE
vendor.ownership: Alphabet Inc. (Mountain View, CA) publishes the Gemma weights; the underlying research lab — Google DeepMind — is headquartered in London, UK. Operated locally by SPIRE.
vendor.foreign_pivot_risk: low — open weights, fully local execution. Cached FP8 checkpoint keeps operating if Alphabet withdraws future releases. Recorded so the auditor sees the UK research-lab origin honestly rather than the page claiming a pure-US LLM.
vendor.contingency: Open weights are mirrored locally on the operator rig. A vendor pivot does not affect already-deployed inference. Replacement candidates: Llama 3.x, Mistral, Qwen — all swap-in via SPIRE_LLM_MODEL alias change.

validation.method: SPIRO eval harness — 178-prompt operator-task suite scored against Marine subject-matter-expert rubric.

inference_cost.notes: Cost reflects amortized rig power per typical operator query (~600 input + 250 output tokens). Fallback when LLM is unreachable: rule-based answers only.

update_policy.cadence: Weights pinned per release; new Gemma generations swap-tested before promotion.

models.name: ThermalHawk · UAS Detector
models.purpose: Thermal-infrared drone detection. Backs BASTION's C-UAS feed inside the multi-sensor fusion correlator.

thornveil_proprietary_v1.summary: Compact thermal-IR detector. Architecture, training methodology, and inference helpers live in the Thornveil-licensed private package thornveil_ml.thermalhawk. Capability + outcome only are disclosed in the public SPIRE repo per LICENSE.md § 2.

provenance.commit_or_version: weights file fingerprinted by SPIRE_THERMALHAWK_WEIGHTS path
provenance.training_data_lineage: Thornveil-curated thermal-IR dataset. Specifics held with Thornveil ML.

hosting.actual: Edge accelerator at C-UAS sensor; weights present-detected by SPIRE backend at boot. Eager-load when SPIRE_THERMALHAWK_EAGER=1 and the licensed package is installed.
hosting.gap: Inference disabled in this build — Thornveil private package not installed in the open-source SPIRE deploy. Sim alert advertises 'weights present, inference disabled' honestly.

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target* for the edge sensor. No Thornveil-specific ATO; the model would inherit the edge enclave's authorization once fielded.

vendor.name: Thornveil LLC
vendor.contingency: Sole-source today. If Thornveil ceases support, the existing checkpoint and licensed package remain deployable; SPIRE can also fall through to alert-only sim mode without the model.

validation.method: Held-out thermal-IR validation set; mAP-style score reported by Thornveil ML

inference_cost.notes: Edge accelerator inference. Falls back to scripted-sim alerts at $0 if the model isn't loaded.

update_policy.cadence: Weights refreshed per Thornveil release cycle (~2x/year).

models.name: BASTION Fusion Correlator
models.purpose: Multi-sensor threat fusion. Groups recent alerts from SENTRY, PULSE, ThermalHawk, PACS, SCADA, and weather feeds by (proximity, time, severity) and emits FusedThreat records.

rule_based_v1.summary: Deterministic windowed correlator over the BASTION alert stream — proximity grouping, time-window decay, severity weighting. Source: backend/fusion.py.

provenance.training_data_lineage: No training. Heuristics tuned against red-team scenarios in backend/tests.

hosting.actual: In-process Python alongside the FastAPI backend

authorization.note: IL-5 is the hosting *target*, not an active authorization. Fusion correlator inherits the receiving enclave's ATO.

validation.method: Red-team scenario harness; precision/recall on labeled coordinated-incident set.

inference_cost.notes: Pure CPU. Fallback is to surface raw alerts un-fused.

update_policy.cadence: Heuristic thresholds reviewed per major incident; full review semi-annual.
